s.note: Billy's first day back at school
s.how: Make 4 ham and cheese sandwiches and cut into quarters. Pack with 4 cheese sticks, a cut apple and 4 small fruit cups. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

Toast 9 slices of bread and layer with 150g chicken, 4 rashers crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo. Cut into small squares with toothpicks. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 buns with mustard, sauce, onion and relish. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 30g cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour over heat until thick. Pour into 4 cups, chill 2 hours and top with cream.

d.how: Shake 1L cold milk with 6 tbsp drinking chocolate until mixed and pour into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
